targets.query:
from(bucket: v.bucket)
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement =~ /sqlserver_sessions.*/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "active_sessions")
  |> last()

from(bucket: v.bucket)
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "cpu")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "usage_system" or r._field == "usage_user")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 1m, fn: mean)
  |> yield()

from(bucket: v.bucket)
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement =~ /sqlserver_wait(stats|_stats)/)
  |> rename(columns: {_value: "wait_ms"})
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 1m, fn: mean)
  |> group(columns: ["wait_type","server_instance"], mode: "by")
  |> top(n:10, columns:["wait_ms"])

from(bucket: v.bucket)
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement =~ /sqlserver_database_io|sqlserver_db_io/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "read_mb_per_sec" or r._field == "write_mb_per_sec")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 1m, fn: mean)
  |> yield()

from(bucket: v.bucket)
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement =~ /sqlserver_performance/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.counter =~ /Page life expectancy/)
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 1m, fn: mean)
  |> yield()

from(bucket: v.bucket)
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement =~ /sqlserver_performance/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.counter =~ /Buffer cache hit ratio/)
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 1m, fn: mean)
  |> yield()
